text: The best dentist ever! I've got an implant there and the ladies working there are so friendly and professional. Even after the sedation was gone I had no pain, pressure, or itching at all. Thanks a lot 🙏🏽 …

Had a difficult broken tooth, and the doctor has repair this very professional. Very friendly doctor and staff. Will recommend this dentist 100%
Have made new appointment for cleaning my teeth next week

Very impressed  with the whole experience of getting new porcelain veneers. Clinic was neat and clean and was serviced by a dedicated cleaner. Communication was excellent. Staff were very friendly and professional. I would highly recommend this dentist for any seeking professional treatments at a competitive price. I’ll definitely go back if I want more veneers in the future. Thanks Dr.Saichol and your team.
Very good very professional I left with my filling done better than England dentists painless procedure phone I'd recommend to any one very cheap also quarter price of England
A truly unique experience, so careful and yet so friendly. Thank you so much for the quick service of my fillings. We will definitely be back.
The dentist was very kind and gentle. They explained everything clearly and made me feel comfortable. My teeth look and feel great. Highly recommend!
Very good dentist, kind and friendly staff. Can recommend

Dazzling Smile have been my dentist for several years and I'll definitely continue using them.  The team are extremely professional and take excellent care of their customers.  They also speak English well.

From my experience, I can say that Dr. Saichol’s a gentle, friendly, professional and highly experienced dentist. Upon examination, she patiently told me my options, so I could make an educated decision for my tooth case. I’m so happy to have found this clinic. I just wish it was closer to Bangkok.

The staff and doctors are awesome. Customer service is top notch.  I had them do an during on a molar during the process I happened to break one of my front teeth eating tough French bread. So they did another implant just as they finished that my other front crown broke.  So they ended up doing 3 implants.
I had a temporary flipper tooth that I damaged 4 days before my daughter was to arrive in Thailand. Of course I was in a panic thinking about family photos. They got me in right of way  and ended up with great photos and a wonderful time. Can't thank them all enough for all the help and great work.

Bua at the front desk is always friendly and accommodating as with the rest of their staff. I have been coming here from Australia for many years and find the standard of work exceptional. I’ve had numerous implants over the years and will keep incorporating holidays with the dentist. Dr Saichol clearly stands alone in her field and I can’t recommend her highly enough.

Dr Saichoi and her staff have given a great service to myself and friends for over 10 years. Very relaxed and professional treatment helps remove the common reluctance most of us have of visiting a dentist! Very modern and clean facility that welcomes both Thai and Foreign patients with excellent English speaking staff to assist at every stage.
I went in for a clean and polish and the dentist was wonderful, with the topical spray I did not feel a thing! Thank you 🙏 …

I had a minor emergency issue with a broken tooth and was taken care of immediately and in a highly professional manner. The clinic is very clean and I can highly recommend it. Fairly priced and smiling receptionists. I will be back for a major overhaul soon.

Been going there for 10 years or so. GREAT dentist! Friends and colleagues have followed me and agree. All staff members are super efficient and friendly. If one could ever love a dentist 😉 this would be the one! …

Attended for a check up as had a broken back tooth down to the gums and wanted it extracted and a filling in another back tooth, was advised tooth was beyond saving and also needed removing.
was very happy to pay 100 Baht for the exam.
Returned today for a double extraction, staff knew i was very nervous about dentists and did a great job calming me down.
Applied a pre numbing gel before the injections as i explained my fear was of the injections. Then gave me surface injections to fully numb the area before giving me the full extraction injections.
Female dentist and assistant were great from start to finish and did a great job calming me down throughout and i would like to thank everyone involved for their help and understanding.
The price was an eye watering 2,100 Baht :-)
Will use again and recommend to everyone i know.
Thanks for a great service.
I came for a check up on Valentines day. The team was amazing, made me feel so comfortable and at ease. They did great work and I will for sure be back!

Dr. Saichol has been treating me for over 12 years during my annual stays in Hua Hin. She has provided services ranging from dental cleaning, crown replacement, capping and preventative work.
When I had to undergo a serious orthodontic treatment, she coordinated with my U.S. orthodontist, kept the treatment progressing so that there were no delays and proactively dealt with issues that arose in full accordance with my treatment plan. More recently, Dr. Saichol replaced my orthodontic retainer both promptly with a very good fit at a very fair price.
The staff is very polite and fluent in English. The office is modern and very clean as well as the dental equipment.
Dr. Saichol has wonderful and soothing manners which will ease the anxiety some patients might feel about visiting a dentist.
I would highly recommend Dazzling Smile Dental Clinic to everyone including my family and friends.
Fast and efficient and did a good job. I’m happy. Very nice Dentist and staff.
Really much more than 5 stars of good service and very kind doctor.

My family and I have used this fine dentist for years and wanted to share our very longstanding, positive experience with Dazzling Smile.
We have always had good communication, friendly service, and very fair prices.  Thank you Dazzling Smile for your professionalism and great service over the years!
Needed a new top plate.  Had a tooth removed, another capped and a 5 tooth denture made and fitted.  Wouldn't hesitate to recommend this clinic.
"My" dentist since more than 10 years. Very friendly, very professional and fair prices. Happy to have this perfect care in Hua Hin.
Dr. Saichol is the best dentist in Hua Hin and better than any I have required in Bangkok over the past 20+ years. We are fortunate indeed to have her in Hua Hin.
I broke a tooth at Gatwick on my way to Thailand. I googled for a great dentist in Hua Hin. Not disappointed!!  Very quick and professional. Less than £30!!!
Dr. Saichol has been my trusted dentist for 10 years when I spend winters in Hua Hin. She is attentive, affordable and skilled at her practice.

Went to pull out a tooth but as it was hard to reach the tooth they cut off a piece of the tooth next to it so it’s easier to take out, so now I have another tooth that is damaged as half of it is cut off! Very dissatisfied. Did more damage then fixing and even had to pay quite a bit for it. Will not go again.
The doctor had gentle hand , the clinic is clean and all staff are very nice 😁 …
She is a really good doctor
The doctor was very sweet and gentle, the prices very reasonable. Will be visiting her for all my dental work hence forth :)

Tooth cleaning bit too expensive for the quality. We asked how much a cleaning and airflow would cost, 1000 Bt was the answer, so the 2 of us made appointments for the next day. After 20 minutes of treatment per person the doctor was ready and charged 1500 Bt per person.
Had the best experience one could possibly have in getting a cleaning, two cavities filled, and a retainer fix. The dentist and staff were all incredibly kind and accommodating.
Clean clinic, nice dentist and caring staffs, professional service with reasonable price. I’m lucky to meet them!
Fantastic experience, I’m afraid for going to dentist, but happy after my visit today, 😊 …
Always a good painless experience at Dazzle Smile, my dentist for more than 10 yrs, that's as old as my implants, still perfect.
Excellent, Dr. Saichol  is the best dentist. Very pleasant staff and surgery spotlessly clean.

Fantastic friendly staff and high quality results. Strongly recommended.

They are very welcoming and gentle.

I will never fear them again.
The team are professional and non-judgmental.
I trust them 100% and have booked to return already.

My wife and I went to Dazzling Smilie for dental hygiene. We got appointments for the very next day. …

Today I had the opportunity to visit the clinic because of a tooth that had previously undergone root canal treatment. The root under the crown had fractured, and the X-ray film showed a large pus sac. It seemed like a rather complex case.
But Dr. Som, Dr. Kung, P' Bua, and the other staff were incredibly lovely and provided service.
They felt like family! They even remembered my name! 💕💕
Everything went well today. If you're looking for a dental clinic in Hua Hin, I highly recommend it.
You can park at the PTT gas station in Bo Fai.
It's just a short walk past the 7-Eleven. Very convenient! 💪💪
The crown of my implant was loose. They looked into it but unfortunately didn't have that European brand. Aside from everyone being very friendly, their efforts didn't cost me anything.
